name: Lighthouse Starting Area Guide
label: Lighthouse
description: The starting coastline: collect Clam, learn the Crab Fishing Rod pools and finish the missing-beer route for the boat key and Forest coordinates.
imageAlt: Official How to Fish screenshot of the opening island near the lighthouse

sections.heading: Main route
bullets: Pick up Clam around the opening area; it is a ground creature, not a rod catch.
Use the Crab Fishing Rod's default pool for Brown Crab and Shrimp.
Buy Hot Dog for Rock Crab and Lobster.
Give the Lighthouse Keeper a Beer, keep the returned Empty Beer Can, catch Spider Crab and complete the hand-in for the boat key.

sections.heading: Creatures to find
paragraphs: The Lighthouse creature route covers Clam, Brown Crab, Rock Crab, Shrimp, Lobster and Spider Crab.

name: Forest Island Guide
label: Forest Island
description: The green Radar marker northwest of the Lighthouse, with the gameplay-linked default Fishing Rod pool, nine Beginner Lure targets and the Leech Bait story chain.
imageAlt: Official How to Fish screenshot of a wooded tropical island

sections.heading: Main route
bullets: Search the ground and bring three leeches to the lady by the lake.
Use the Leech Bait she returns to summon Giant Piranha.
Clear its smaller piranhas first, then defeat the boss.
Return the named boss trophy to receive Desert Island coordinates.

sections.heading: Fishing setup
paragraphs: Mackerel, Gar and Pike are in the gameplay-linked default Fishing Rod pool. Beginner Lure adds Cod, Pike, Piranha, Triggerfish, Goby, Salmon, Goldfish, Perch and a low-weight Sunfish result.

sections.heading: Optional completion
paragraphs: The $40 Beginner Boss Lure has an even Sunfish and The Old Pike pool. Giant Piranha is the story encounter that advances the island route.

name: Desert Island Guide
label: Desert Island
description: The yellow Radar marker and Standard Lure tier, where an endangered-creature trade opens the Carrot route, Coconut catches Bing Bong and Blue Shark unlocks the grill.
imageAlt: Official How to Fish screenshot of the giant Pufferfish battle
sourceLabel: Official boss screenshot + game bait data

sections.heading: Main route
bullets: Catch an eligible endangered creature with the Standard Lure; Needlefish and Seahorse are confirmed options.
Give the eligible catch to the tourist and use the Carrot reward to summon the Pufferfish.
Move after short damage windows rather than standing in its charge path.
Return the Pufferfish fin to unlock the red Rocks Island marker.

sections.heading: Fishing and special bait
paragraphs: The Standard Lure table includes Bowlfish and a low-weight Blue Shark result; Salmon belongs to Beginner Lure instead. Coconut costs $350 on this island and has a dedicated Bing Bong pool.

sections.heading: Grill route
paragraphs: The Standard Boss Lure costs $280 and gives Blue Shark a dedicated pool. Bring the defeated shark to the Grillmaster to start the grill; cooking can increase item value up to about 1.5× before burning destroys the value.

name: Rocks Island Guide
label: Rocks Island
description: The red Radar marker and Professional Lure tier, with the Tuna-to-Albatross story encounter plus roulette, slots and late-game weapon upgrades.
imageAlt: Official How to Fish screenshot showing a late-game gold weapon and open island water

sections.heading: Main route
bullets: Use Professional Boss Lure to summon Tuna.
Keep the defeated Tuna instead of selling it.
Place it on the grass to draw in the Albatross.
Return the Albatross head to the scared islander to unlock the pink Volcano marker.

sections.heading: Professional Lure pool
paragraphs: Professional Lure can hook Sengarat, Red Snapper, Tigerfish, Parrotfish, Bass, Halibut, Flying Fish, Eel, Voxelfish, Dripper, Tuna and Seahorse. Use Professional Boss Lure when you want a dedicated Tuna encounter.

name: Volcano Island Guide
label: Volcano Island
description: The final pink Radar marker: a separate military objective, the Scientist's Whale Bait hand-ins, Scientific Lure farming and the Bowhead-to-mutated-whale ending chain.
imageAlt: Official How to Fish screenshot of late-game equipment on a tropical island
sourceLabel: Unpacked NPC quest mapping + final-route data

sections.heading: Story route
bullets: Speak to the military officer and the Scientist; their quest records are separate and both should be checked before the ending route.
Complete the Scientist's requested-catch hand-ins to receive the Fish Bucket used for Bowhead Whale.
Keep the defeated Bowhead Whale and carry it into the Volcano trigger.
Defeat Mutated Bowhead Whale, then take the final transport to trigger the finish-game check.
For Handyman, the achievement code checks the finishing hit on the final boss: use a bare-fist-strength attack dealing under 5 damage for the last blow.

sections.heading: Collection and money
paragraphs: Scientific Lure costs $500 and reaches the five regular deep-sea species. The optional Scientific Boss Lure costs $5,800 and summons Goblin Shark, a commonly missed Collector target.
